top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a quantitative prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle, 2011) with an experimental discovery (correlated insulating and superconducting states, 2018) that nature did not have to supply, now reproduced by many independent groups and extended to other moire platforms. The three-name allocation is the one the case supports and the citation, which claims no pairing mechanism, handles the maturity worry. P002 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is a mature, cleanly attributed and independently confirmed achievement, but so far mainly delivers accuracy and confirmations of existing theory, so I rank it second; an award is still preferable to no award.
